column2: Staff and Scheduling Management
Test the core workflows of staff administration and shift management including edge cases
Passed
Test Case Description
Verify successful invitation to a new staff by Admin/Manager
column3:
1. Login to Web as CLINIC_MANAGER or ADMIN.
2. Go to 'Quản lý nhân viên'.
3. Click 'Mời nhân viên'.
4. Enter valid email address and assign a role (e.g., Vet).
5. Click 'Gửi lời mời'.
column4:
Invitation is sent to the email.
Toast message: 'Gửi lời mời thành công'.

column2: Verify invitation to an already existing staff email
column3:
1. Go to 'Mời nhân viên'.
2. Enter an email that is already registered as staff.
3. Click 'Gửi lời mời'.
column4:
Submission fails.
Error message: 'Email đã tồn tại trong hệ thống'.

column2: Verify invitation validation on empty email
column3:
1. Leave the email field empty.
2. Click 'Gửi lời mời'.
column4:
Submission blocked.
Validation message: 'Vui lòng nhập email'.

column2: Verify deactivating a staff member without active bookings
column3:
1. Open staff list as CLINIC_MANAGER.
2. Click 'Xóa' or 'Vô hiệu hóa' (Deactivate) on a staff record.
3. Confirm in the dialog.
column4:
Staff status changes to INACTIVE.
Toast message: 'Cập nhật trạng thái thành công' / 'Xóa nhân viên thành công'.

column2: Verify deactivating a staff member with currently assigned active bookings
column3:
1. Click 'Vô hiệu hóa' on a Staff who has PENDING/CONFIRMED bookings.
2. Confirm action.
column4:
System prevents action or warns manager to reassign bookings first.
Error message: 'Nhân viên này đang có lịch hẹn kích hoạt, vui lòng chuyển giao trước khi xóa'.

column2: Verify viewing and filtering the staff directory on Web
column3:
1. Login to Web as CLINIC_MANAGER.
2. Navigate to 'Quản lý nhân viên'.
3. Use Search bar to enter a staff name.
4. Filter by Role 'VET'.
column4: List updates correctly to show matching staff members. Table columns (Name, Role, Status) display accurately.

column2: Verify displaying empty state for search
column3: 1. Search for a non-existent staff name 'XYZ_Random'.
column4: Table shows 'Không có dữ liệu' (No data).

column2: Verify staff can view their shifts on Mobile/Web
column3:
1. Login as STAFF.
2. Navigate to 'Lịch làm việc'.
3. Select current week.
column4: A calendar or list view displaying shift times is shown. Details match manager assignment.

column2: Verify staff viewing next month's schedule
column3:
1. Navigate to 'Lịch làm việc'.
2. Switch calendar to the next month.
column4: Shifts (if created) are shown, else calendar is blank.

column2: Verify successful creation of a shift by Manager
column3:
1. Login to Web as CLINIC_MANAGER.
2. Go to 'Quản lý ca làm việc'.
3. Click 'Tạo ca làm việc'.
4. Select a Staff, Date (tomorrow), Start time (08:00), End time (12:00).
5. Click 'Lưu'.
column4:
Shift is created in the database and shown on calendar.
Toast message: 'Tạo ca làm việc thành công'.

column2: Verify validation when creating overlapping shifts for the same staff
column3:
1. Select the same Staff and Date as an existing shift.
2. Choose a Time range that overlaps (e.g., 10:00 to 14:00).
3. Click 'Lưu'.
column4:
Submission is blocked.
Error message: 'Ca làm việc bị trùng lặp'.

column2: Verify validation when End Time is before Start Time
column3:
1. Select a Staff and Date.
2. Choose Start time 14:00, End time 10:00.
3. Click 'Lưu'.
column4:
Submission is blocked.
Validation text: 'Thời gian kết thúc phải sau thời gian bắt đầu'.

column2: Verify Manager viewing all shifts in weekly view
column3:
1. Login as CLINIC_MANAGER.
2. Go to 'Quản lý ca làm việc'.
3. Select 'Tuần' (Weekly) view.
column4: All staff shifts are plotted accurately across the 7 days.

column2: Verify filtering shifts by a specific staff member
column3: 1. On 'Quản lý ca làm việc', select a Staff name from the dropdown filter.
column4: Calendar only displays shifts belonging to that specifically selected Staff.

column2: Verify successful deletion of a future shift by Manager
column3:
1. Select a shift scheduled in the future on the calendar.
2. Click 'Xóa ca'.
3. Confirm in the popup.
column4:
Shift is removed.
Toast message: 'Xóa ca làm việc thành công'.

column2: Verify Manager is blocked from deleting a shift that is currently running or in the past
column3:
1. Try to select a shift from yesterday or currently happening.
2. Look for 'Xóa ca' button.
column4: The delete button is hidden or disabled, OR an error 'Không thể xóa ca làm việc trong quá khứ' appears if invoked via API.
